newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine currency reserves slip to $1.85 bln.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine currency reserves slip to $1.85 bln.

text.p: Ukraine's hard currency reserves slipped to $1.85 billion on March 31 from $1.96 billion at the end of February, a central bank monthly report said on Monday.

The report pointed out that February reserves had been recalculated to $1.96 billion from $2.0 billion in a previous issue. Ukraine's SDR credits rose to $41.1 million in March from $40.7 million in February.
In 1996 hard currency reserves almost doubled to $1.76 billion from $910 million in the end of 1995.
